n: 4.5 cu. ft. Capacity Washer with Stainless Steel Basket, Cold Plus and Wash Boost
desc: Boost the wash performance of any cycle by adding an extra 15 minutes of soaking power for stubborn stains or more powerful agitation for heavily soiled items..Wash without compromise in cold water. When selected Cold Plus adjusts wash action to achieve a great clean on any wash cycle while saving up to 90% on energy costs * Energy savings using cold water vs. hot water for the normal cycle with a max load using the DOE test procedure to measure machine and hot water energy..44 H x 27 W x 27 D
hl: Power through laundry day in less time than ever before with a large capacity washing machine that can easily handle big loads and bulky items.
This durable, built-in, Dual Action Agitator provides better circulation and turnover of clothes to achieve a deep clean while being gentle on your clothes.
Enjoy peace of mind for years to come with a washer warranty that backs the motor with a dependable 10-year limited warranty.
Remove 99% of bacteria with a dedicated cycle that lets you sanitize with Oxi.
Press a single button on this deep fill washer to add an additional 3 gallons of water or press and hold the button to fill up to a full 26 gallons.
Ensure that all your garments are free from detergent, fabric softener, stubborn soils and even pet hair in this deep rinse washing machine.
